description: Golden vectors for plan columnar@5. Hex is body bytes only. All vectors compile with plan: columnar.

valid.name: col-int-delta-for
valid.description: constant stride: delta frame of reference packs to width 0, so the payload is empty

valid.name: col-int-delta-still-wins
valid.description: one huge jump among tiny ones makes bit-packing wider than varints, so plain delta wins

valid.name: col-int-for-narrow
valid.description: four possible values cost two bits each, not eight

valid.name: col-int-for-constant-width-zero
valid.description: a constant column packs to width 0 and carries no payload bytes at all

valid.name: col-int-pfor-outlier
valid.description: seven values inside seven bits and one outlier: patched frame packs everyone at L=6 and the outlier alone pays its high bits (14 B vs delta 15, raw 17, frame 19)

valid.name: col-enum-three-bit-indices
valid.description: a six-member enum spends three bits per value, not a whole byte; indices 5,0,3,1 pack into two bytes with zero padding

valid.name: col-enum-single-member-zero-width
valid.description: a single-member enum has width zero: the column carries no payload bytes at all

invalidDecode.name: col-int-for-nonzero-padding
invalidDecode.description: two 2-bit values leave six padding bits; nonzero padding would give one value two encodings

invalidDecode.name: col-enum-index-out-of-range
invalidDecode.description: index 6 is representable in the three-bit width but names no member of a six-member enum

invalidDecode.name: col-int-pfor-zero-high-part
invalidDecode.description: an exception row whose high part decodes to zero would give the value a second encoding

invalidDecode.name: col-int-pfor-invalid-widths
invalidDecode.description: a high width of zero is invalid: an exception always has a non-zero high part

invalidDecode.name: col-int-delta-for-single-row
invalidDecode.description: delta frame of reference needs two values; with one there is no difference to frame

packedDecode.name: col-string-packed-stored-block
packedDecode.description: decode-only: blob is a deflate-raw stored block, valid for any inflater

packedDecode.name: col-string-packed-empty-total
packedDecode.description: decode-only: a packed column of one empty string (total=0), valid raw-DEFLATE empty stream

profiled.description: Vectors compiled with plan columnar@5 AND the given profile. Packing is disabled so the encoding is fully deterministic.

valid.name: dict-two-arrays-distinct-ordinals
valid.description: each array is its own column: 'red' is code 1 under leaf 0 and code 2 under leaf 1

valid.name: dict-two-byte-codes
valid.description: codes past 127 take two uvarint bytes, which the cost model must charge

valid.name: dict-two-byte-codes-decide-the-mode
valid.description: Codes 128–130 fit one packed byte each at w=8, so v5 dictionary mode beats plain where v4's two-byte uvarint codes did not.

valid.name: grammar-sequential-ids
valid.description: three ids match lit/num/lit/num; the base36 lane rides raw varints and the hex lane costs its true bits — 15 bytes for 39 bytes of strings

valid.name: grammar-escape-mix
valid.description: one non-matching value escapes: escape count 1, bitmap bit 1, lanes over the two matched rows, then the literal

valid.name: derived-conform-and-escape
valid.description: the source column decides the target: two conforming rows ship zero bytes, the one mismatch escapes

invalidDecode.name: grammar-lane-above-limit
invalidDecode.description: a two-digit base-10 token caps its lane at 99; a lane value of 100 cannot render

invalidDecode.name: grammar-escape-count-over-k
invalidDecode.description: an escape count beyond the participating rows is unpayable

invalidDecode.name: grammar-escape-popcount-mismatch
invalidDecode.description: the escape bitmap must carry exactly the declared number of set bits

invalidDecode.name: derived-source-not-in-dict
invalidDecode.description: a non-escaped derived row whose source value sits outside the source dictionary cannot be reconstructed

invalidDecode.name: dict-width-over-14
invalidDecode.description: fifteen bits of code width exceeds what any dictionary can need
